Subject: Invoice routing & billing contact setup — preferred channel

Hi Jules / Acme finance team,

Quick question as we finalize the paperwork for DEAL-4491: do you prefer to receive Redwood invoices via your vendor portal (preferred by many of our customers) or as email PDF attachments to finance.ops@acme-corp.com? We can support either.

If portal: please let us know the vendor ID you want us to use and any onboarding steps (portal contact, accepted file formats). If email: confirm the recipient and any required PO/PO number placement.

Also: please confirm the billing contact we should set in your system (name, email, phone) and whether Acme requires a W-9 or other tax forms on file. For EU entities we normally collect VAT/Tax ID — let me know if that applies.

Attaching our invoice template (PDF) and we can also upload to your portal once we have the vendor ID. Proposed default cadence is monthly in arrears; happy to align to your cadence if you need net-30, net-45, or PO-driven billing.

Next step: once you confirm portal vs email and the contact, I will coordinate upload and make sure the first two invoices are duplicated to email while the portal onboarding completes.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193

Attachments: Redwood_Invoice_Template.pdf
From: Jules Martin <jules.martin@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice routing & billing contact setup — preferred channel

Marissa, thanks — we generally prefer vendor portal onboarding for permanent vendors to keep everything in AP. Two quick asks before we can finalize:

1) We need Redwood's vendor remit address and a completed W-9 on file.
2) Please confirm the exact vendor name you register as (for tax/1099 purposes) and the remit email for any payment notifications.

Also: our portal requires either the company tax ID or the W-9 upload and sometimes a vendor registration form that includes your primary billing contact. If you can provide the W-9 and a preferred billing contact email, I can kick off the portal invite.

We can accept emailed PDFs for the first two invoices while onboarding completes, but after that the portal is our source of truth. Note: we will require the PO number to be visible on each invoice.

Thanks — I’ll loop Lisa Park (AP manager) if there are edge cases.

Best,
Jules
Finance Operations Partner | Acme Corporation
